item.title: CONFIRMED: CELTIC’S SUNDAY IBROX CUP DATE
item.description: CELTIC will play Rangers in the Scottish Cup quarter-final at Ibrox on Sunday March 8. The intriguing last-16 encounter will kick off at 1pm and will be covered live by Premier Sport. The Hoops can claim a ticket allocation of up to 20 per cent of the capacity of the ground, as per the competition’s rules, [...]

item.description: NEW BHOY Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain will start on the bench for Celtic’s Premiership encounter against Livingston at Parkhead this evening.
